preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= n <= 100 for n, m in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Input contains integers n (total files) and m (files to delete) where 1 ≤ m ≤ n ≤ 100.

preconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()]) == n
preconditions.description: Exactly n non-empty filenames follow the first line, each on a separate line.

preconditions.expression: all(len(filename) <= 100 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789.' for c in filename) for filename in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each filename is non-empty, length ≤ 100, and contains only lowercase letters, digits, or dots.

preconditions.expression: all(filename != other_filename for filename in filenames for other_filename in filenames if filename != other_filename)
preconditions.description: All filenames are distinct, where `filenames` is the list of all n filenames.

preconditions.expression: len([int(x) for x in stdin.splitlines()[-1].split()]) == m and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.splitlines()[-1].split())
preconditions.description: The last line contains exactly m distinct integers in ascending order, each between 1 and n (inclusive), representing indices of files to delete.

preconditions.expression: set([int(x) for x in stdin.splitlines()[-1].split()]) == set(range(1, m+1))
preconditions.description: The indices of files to delete are exactly 1, 2, ..., m (no gaps or duplicates).

postconditions.description: If a valid pattern exists, the first line of stdout is 'Yes' and the second line contains a non-empty pattern string.
If no valid pattern exists, stdout is exactly 'No' on a single line.

postconditions.expression: all(len(pattern) == len(filename) for filename in to_delete_filenames) and all(len(pattern) == len(filename) for filename in other_filenames)
postconditions.description: The pattern's length must match the length of every filename in both the to-delete set and the non-delete set, where `to_delete_filenames` and `other_filenames` are the filenames corresponding to the delete indices and others, respectively.

postconditions.expression: all(any(pattern[i] == '?' or pattern[i] == filename[i] for i in range(len(pattern))) for filename in to_delete_filenames)
postconditions.description: Every filename in the to-delete set must match the pattern, where `to_delete_filenames` are the filenames indexed by the delete indices.

postconditions.expression: all(not all(pattern[i] == '?' or pattern[i] == filename[i] for i in range(len(pattern))) for filename in other_filenames)
postconditions.description: No filename outside the to-delete set matches the pattern, where `other_filenames` are the filenames not indexed by the delete indices.
